proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ _ f a
  change f a = inner ℂ _ (f.gnsNonUnitalStarAlgHom a _)
  rw [PositiveLinearMap.gnsNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply_coe, UniformSpace.Completion.inner_coe]
  simp [PositiveLinearMap.preGNS_inner_def, PositiveLinearMap.leftMulMapPreGNS]
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (f : @PositiveLinearMap ℂ A ℂ _ _ _ _ Complex.partialOrder _ _) (a : A), f a = inner ℂ ((f.toPreGNS 1 : f.PreGNS) : f.GNS) (f.gnsStarAlgHom a ((f.toPreGNS 1 : f.PreGNS) : f.GNS))
